recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to replace the THO measure-improvement-notation value set with v3 ObservationValue descendants should be handled as a new CQI/terminology decision, likely in THO/UTG rather than as a core source cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-19446 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for CQI. It requested changing Measure and MeasureReport improvementNotation from code to CodeableConcept with a required binding to the existing value set, then updating the value set to HL7 terminology under v3 ObservationValue _MeasurementImprovementNotation after harmonization.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#780fae5356. That commit changed the historical Measure and MeasureReport spreadsheet sources from code to CodeableConcept and updated the MeasureImprovementNotation wording/value-set description. The current XML resources are post-refactor descendants of that source.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active current-build resources. The current XML has group-level improvementNotation as CodeableConcept and binds to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/measure-improvement-notation. v3 ObservationValue contains _MeasurementImprovementNotation with IncrIsImp and DecrIsImp descendants, but later applied decisions moved the FHIR measure-improvement-notation CodeSystem to THO and then relaxed Measure and MeasureReport improvementNotation bindings to extensible. Checked-in SVG diagrams still contain stale generated-looking binding/anchor text, but authoritative XML is correct and SVG-only edits are out of scope for this reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because replacing the current THO value set with a v3 ObservationValue-based binding, or restoring required binding strength, would conflict with later applied decisions FHIR-39623 and FHIR-53101.

related_jiras.note: The same 780fae5356 commit updated MeasureImprovementNotation code wording, but this audit decides only FHIR-19446.
Moved measure-related code systems, including measure-improvement-notation, out of core and confirmed THO as the source.
Reworked improvementNotation placement/guidance for R6 and provides context for the current group-level elements.
Explicitly changed Measure and MeasureReport improvementNotation bindings to extensible.
Later Measure approach cleanup removed/deprecated root calculation elements, leaving group-level current source as the relevant surface.
